MOST SECRET

To: Mr. Gibbs, M.I.5.
From: Deputy Director.

Thank you for your minute of 2nd March with regard to S. Retzlaw, returning Neame's two letters to me of the 27th February.

In the circumstances, I should prefer that your Department should notify Neame of the officer in your organisation whom he should contact in this matter.

3. 3. 42.
